benchmarks.question: Show the 20 client groups with the largest CASA outflow in Q2 FY2026, with the CASA moved into time deposits, their total deposit movement, and whether the money mostly moved to time deposits or left the bank.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT `Client Group`,
         MEASURE(`CASA Movement USD`)     AS casa_movement_usd,
         MEASURE(`Transferred to TD USD`) AS casa_moved_to_td_usd,
         MEASURE(`Deposit Movement USD`)  AS total_deposit_movement_usd
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_deposits
  WHERE `Fiscal Quarter` = :fiscal_quarter
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Client Group`, casa_movement_usd, casa_moved_to_td_usd, total_deposit_movement_usd,
       CASE WHEN total_deposit_movement_usd >= try_divide(casa_movement_usd,2) THEN 'Mostly moved to time deposits'
            ELSE 'Mostly left the bank' END AS where_it_went
FROM g
WHERE casa_movement_usd < 0
ORDER BY casa_movement_usd ASC
LIMIT 20
benchmarks.expected_sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT `Client Group`,
         MEASURE(`CASA Movement USD`)     AS casa_movement_usd,
         MEASURE(`Transferred to TD USD`) AS casa_moved_to_td_usd,
         MEASURE(`Deposit Movement USD`)  AS total_deposit_movement_usd
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_deposits
  WHERE `Fiscal Quarter` = 'FY2026-Q2'
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Client Group`, casa_movement_usd, casa_moved_to_td_usd, total_deposit_movement_usd,
       CASE WHEN total_deposit_movement_usd >= casa_movement_usd / 2 THEN 'Mostly moved to time deposits'
            ELSE 'Mostly left the bank' END AS where_it_went
FROM g
WHERE casa_movement_usd < 0
ORDER BY casa_movement_usd ASC
LIMIT 20

benchmarks.question: For Hong Kong, month by month from June to August 2026, what were the CASA movement, the CASA transferred into time deposits and the CASA ratio?
benchmarks.genie_sql:

  `Month`,
  MEASURE(`CASA Movement USD`) AS `casa_movement_usd`,
  MEASURE(`Transferred to TD USD`) AS `casa_transferred_to_td_usd`,
  MEASURE(`CASA Ratio %`) AS `casa_ratio`
FROM `smbc_genie`.`metrics`.`mv_tb_deposits`
WHERE `Booking Country` = 'HK'
  AND `Month` >= DATE'2026-06-01'
  AND `Month` < DATE'2026-09-01'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Month` ASC

       MEASURE(`CASA Movement USD`)     AS casa_movement_usd,
       MEASURE(`Transferred to TD USD`) AS casa_moved_to_td_usd,

FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_deposits
WHERE `Booking Country` = 'HK' AND `Month` BETWEEN DATE'2026-06-01' AND DATE'2026-08-01'

benchmarks.question: List every legal entity whose total deposits held steady year on year at end-September 2026 (within plus or minus 10% of end-September 2025), with its client group, booking country, both month-end balances and the YoY change.
benchmarks.genie_sql: SELECT `Client` AS `legal_entity`, `Client Group` AS `client_group`, `Booking Country` AS `booking_country`, MEASURE(`End of Month Balance USD`) AS `end_sep_2026_balance_usd`, MEASURE(`End of Month Balance Prior Year USD`) AS `end_sep_2025_balance_usd`, TRY_DIVIDE(MEASURE(`End of Month Balance USD`), MEASURE(`End of Month Balance Prior Year USD`)) - 1 AS `yoy_change` FROM `smbc_genie`.`metrics`.`mv_tb_deposits` WHERE `Month` = DATE'2026-09-01' AND `Client` IS NOT NULL AND `Client Group` IS NOT NULL AND `Booking Country` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL HAVING MEASURE(`End of Month Balance Prior Year USD`) > 0 AND ABS(TRY_DIVIDE(MEASURE(`End of Month Balance USD`), MEASURE(`End of Month Balance Prior Year USD`)) - 1) <= 0.10 ORDER BY `yoy_change` ASC, `legal_entity` ASC
benchmarks.expected_sql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT `Client`, `Client Group`, `Booking Country`,
         MEASURE(`End of Month Balance USD`)            AS deposits_sep_2026_usd,
         MEASURE(`End of Month Balance Prior Year USD`) AS deposits_sep_2025_usd,
         MEASURE(`Balance YoY %`)                       AS deposits_yoy
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_deposits
  WHERE `Is Latest Month`
  GROUP BY ALL
) WHERE deposits_yoy BETWEEN -0.10 AND 0.10
ORDER BY deposits_sep_2026_usd DESC

benchmarks.question: Which legal entities saw their payment volume through us drop by more than 30% in H1 FY2026 versus H1 FY2025 (with at least USD 1m of payments in H1 FY2025) while their average month-end deposits held steady within plus or minus 10%? Show both halves' payment volume, the payment change and the deposit change.
benchmarks.genie_sql: SELECT * FROM `smbc_genie`.`gold`.`fn_tb_payment_drop_steady_deposits`(fiscal_half => 'FY2026-H1')
benchmarks.expected_sql:
WITH pay AS (
  SELECT `Client`, `Fiscal Half`, MEASURE(`Payment Volume USD`) AS payment_volume_usd
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_payments
  WHERE `Fiscal Half` IN ('FY2025-H1', 'FY2026-H1')
  GROUP BY ALL
), p AS (
  SELECT `Client`,
         sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = 'FY2025-H1' THEN payment_volume_usd END) AS payments_h1_fy2025_usd,
         sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = 'FY2026-H1' THEN payment_volume_usd END) AS payments_h1_fy2026_usd
  FROM pay GROUP BY `Client`
), dep AS (
  SELECT `Client`, `Fiscal Half`, `Month`, MEASURE(`End of Month Balance USD`) AS deposits_usd
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_deposits
  WHERE `Fiscal Half` IN ('FY2025-H1', 'FY2026-H1')
  GROUP BY ALL
), d AS (
  SELECT `Client`,
         sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = 'FY2025-H1' THEN deposits_usd END) / 6 AS avg_deposits_h1_fy2025_usd,
         sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = 'FY2026-H1' THEN deposits_usd END) / 6 AS avg_deposits_h1_fy2026_usd
  FROM dep GROUP BY `Client`
)
SELECT p.`Client`, p.payments_h1_fy2025_usd, coalesce(p.payments_h1_fy2026_usd, 0) AS payments_h1_fy2026_usd,
       coalesce(p.payments_h1_fy2026_usd, 0) / p.payments_h1_fy2025_usd - 1 AS payment_volume_yoy,
       d.avg_deposits_h1_fy2026_usd / d.avg_deposits_h1_fy2025_usd - 1 AS avg_deposits_change
FROM p JOIN d ON d.`Client` = p.`Client`
WHERE p.payments_h1_fy2025_usd >= 1000000
  AND coalesce(p.payments_h1_fy2026_usd, 0) / p.payments_h1_fy2025_usd - 1 < -0.30
  AND abs(d.avg_deposits_h1_fy2026_usd / d.avg_deposits_h1_fy2025_usd - 1) <= 0.10
ORDER BY p.payments_h1_fy2025_usd - coalesce(p.payments_h1_fy2026_usd, 0) DESC
